description: Retrieve information about LXD storage volumes in a specific storage pool.

parameters.name: client_cert
parameters.description: The client certificate file path. If not specified, it defaults to $HOME/.config/lxc/client.crt.

parameters.name: client_key
parameters.description: The client certificate key file path. If not specified, it defaults to $HOME/.config/lxc/client.key.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of a specific storage volume to retrieve information about. If not specified, information about all volumes in the pool are returned.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.description: Name of the storage pool to query for volumes. This parameter is required.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project of the storage volume. See https://documentation.ubuntu.com/lxd/en/latest/projects/.

parameters.name: snap_url
parameters.description: The Unix domain socket path when LXD is installed by snap package manager. Default: "unix:/var/snap/lxd/common/lxd/unix.socket"

parameters.name: trust_password
parameters.description: The client trusted password. You need to set this password on the LXD server before running this module using the following command: lxc config set core.trust_password <some random password> See https://www.stgraber.org/2016/04/18/lxd-api-direct-interaction/. If trust_password is set, this module sends a request for authentication before sending any requests.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter volumes by type. Common types include container, virtual-machine, image, and custom. If not specified, all volume types are returned.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The Unix domain socket path or the https URL for the LXD server. Default: "unix:/var/lib/lxd/unix.socket"

examples:
- name: Get information about all volumes in the default storage pool
  community.general.lxd_storage_volume_info:
    pool: default
  register: result

- name: Get information about a specific volume
  community.general.lxd_storage_volume_info:
    pool: default
    name: my-volume
  register: result

- name: Get information about all custom volumes in a pool
  community.general.lxd_storage_volume_info:
    pool: default
    type: custom
  register: result

- name: Get volume information via HTTPS connection
  community.general.lxd_storage_volume_info:
    url: https://127.0.0.1:8443
    trust_password: mypassword
    pool: default
    name: my-volume
  register: result

- name: Get volume information for a specific project
  community.general.lxd_storage_volume_info:
    project: myproject
    pool: default
  register: result

- name: Get container volumes only
  community.general.lxd_storage_volume_info:
    pool: default
    type: container
  register: result

return_values.name: logs
return_values.description: The logs of requests and responses. Returned: when ansible-playbook is invoked with -vvvv. Sample: [{"request": {"json": null, "method": "GET", "timeout": null, "url": "/1.0/storage-pools/default/volumes"}, "response": {"json": {"status": "Success", "type": "sync"}}, "type": "sent request"}]

return_values.name: storage_volumes
return_values.description: List of LXD storage volumes. Returned: success Sample: [{"config": {"size": "10GiB"}, "content_type": "filesystem", "description": "My custom volume", "location": "none", "name": "my-volume", "type": "custom", "used_by": []}]

return_values.name: config
return_values.description: Configuration of the storage volume. Returned: success

return_values.name: content_type
return_values.description: Content type of the volume (filesystem or block). Returned: success

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: Description of the storage volume. Returned: success

return_values.name: location
return_values.description: Cluster member location for the volume. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the storage volume. Returned: success

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: The type of the storage volume. Returned: success

return_values.name: used_by
return_values.description: List of resources using this storage volume. Returned: success
